_schema.status: live | coming-soon. Live entries must have file.tag/name/sha256; the site build downloads the asset, verifies the sha256, and reads everything else (name, description, instructions, version, tables) from inside the .adf itself. Coming-soon entries render from the curated fields here.
_schema.file: Release asset in this repo: https://github.com/rawl-ai/rawl-agents/releases/download/<tag>/<name>. Assets are named <name>.adf; the version lives in adf_meta (key "version") and the release tag.
_schema.naming: Agents get botanical given names (ash, sage, willow, ...). The family signature is the filename: <name>.adf. Role lives in the tagline, never the name.

agents.tagline: A portable personal assistant that learns your environment and improves through use.
An ADF expert. Ask it anything about the format, the spec, or ADF Studio.

agents.name: willow
agents.tagline: An agent that builds agents. Describe what you need and it raises a new .adf.
agents.description: Willow scaffolds new agents: give it a goal and it creates the .adf, writes the instructions, wires the tools and channels, and hands you a file ready to grow.

agents.name: ivy
agents.tagline: A research agent that watches your sources and delivers source-backed briefings.
agents.description: Ivy watches the sources you care about, separates signal from noise, and delivers briefings where every claim carries its source. One-off deep dives or standing watchlists, on your schedule.

agents.name: oak
agents.tagline: A training coach that builds your program, logs your sessions, and adjusts as you go.
agents.description: Oak builds a program around your goals, equipment, and constraints, logs every session, and progresses the plan from what the log says. A steady coach, not a doctor: the record decides, and pain goes to professionals.

agents.name: aspen
agents.tagline: A personal-development agent: goals into steps, habits tracked, check-ins that keep you honest.
agents.description: Aspen turns goals into milestones and next actions, tracks progress on a shared scoreboard, and checks in on the channels you choose. Progress noticed, slippage called out — kindly, and never past the cadence you set.

agents.name: cedar
agents.tagline: A business-operations agent that staffs itself: it spawns the specialists the work needs, with your approval.
agents.description: Cedar triages the work, keeps the ops cadence, and tracks every delegation in a ledger where done means verified. When the load calls for it, it proposes and spawns specialist agents — every spawn owner-approved, every child a sovereign .adf you keep.
